$comment: Application Rules a company can set without a code change. Read by functions/shared/applicationRules.js and src/config/applicationRules.js (mirrors) and rendered by the settings UI. Every default reproduces the behaviour the wizard had before the rules existed, so a company that never opens the settings sees no change. Labels are written for company staff, not engineers.

enforcementOptions.label: Allow — accept the application as entered
Warn — tell the applicant, but let them continue
Block — the applicant cannot continue until it is fixed

rules.label: Require previous addresses when the applicant has lived at their current address for less than 3 years
rules.help: When on, an applicant who answers No to “lived here 3 years or more” must add at least one complete previous address before continuing.

rules.label: Commercial-driving experience choices shown to applicants
rules.help: Untick a choice to hide it from your application. A carrier that does not hire recent graduates can hide “Student / Recent Grad”; another carrier can leave it on.

rules.label: Vehicle types applicants describe their experience with
rules.help: Untick a vehicle type to remove it from the application. Answers already saved for a hidden type stay on the record.

rules.label: Wording for each vehicle type
rules.help: Optional. Change how a vehicle type is named for your applicants; the saved answer keys never change.

rules.label: If the license expiration date is in the past
rules.help: The check runs the moment the applicant changes the date.

rules.label: If the medical card expiration date is in the past
rules.help: Only applies while the medical card question is shown.

rules.label: Require complete details for every other-state license held in the past 3 years
rules.help: When the applicant says they held a license in another state, at least one complete record (state, number, class, expiration) is required.

options.label: Ask for it, but let the applicant decline
Required — the applicant cannot continue without authorizing it

rules.label: Motor vehicle record (MVR) authorization
rules.help: The authorization wording itself is a versioned agreement (see Agreements). This setting only decides whether declining stops the application.

rules.label: When the applicant reports moving violations, require at least one complete violation record
rules.help: A complete record has a date, the charge and the location.

rules.label: When the applicant reports accidents, require complete accident details
rules.help: Every accident must then record the date, what happened, the number of fatalities, the number of injuries and whether hazardous materials were spilled.

rules.label: If the employment history does not account for the required period
rules.help: Gaps, schooling and military service count toward the period, not only employers.

rules.label: Years of history the application must account for
rules.help: FMCSA asks for 3 years for most drivers and 10 years for CDL drivers. The DOT application text still asks for the full 10 years.

rules.label: When the applicant reports a felony conviction, require an explanation

options.label: Collected in the application (General Questions step)

rules.label: Hours of Service statement for the past 7 days
rules.help: Adds the 49 CFR 395.8(j)(2) statement: on-duty hours for each of the past 7 days and when the applicant was last relieved from duty. To collect it after the application instead, add it as a post-application form under Documents.
